derivation.participants: Copy only source.speakers whose ID occurs as a source.segments speakerID, preserving source order, UUID bytes and displayName bytes. Both represented speakers are fictional.
derivation.criteria: Synthetic authorized criteria with numeric database IDs 31, 32 and 33, ordered ascending; labels are Synthetic criterion followed by the corresponding ID. These examples grant no policy or data access.

cursor.encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON in implementation object insertion order, then canonical unpadded base64url

options-first-page.json.case: Unbound needsParticipant receipt; null participantID and empty criteriaIDs; first two criteria, with the third row establishing has_more and a cursor after criterion32.

options-next-page.json.case: Same unbound receipt and participants; echo the first-page cursor, return criterion33 and explicit next_cursor:null with has_more:false.

options-bound.json.case: After explicit binding, queued receipt with the represented participant003 and criterion33 selected; retain first-page criteria31/32 and the valid next cursor. Selected criteria may be outside this page. canResolvePending is false.

derivation.nullableFields: Every response explicitly includes participantID, criteriaIDs, pagination.cursor and pagination.next_cursor; null is emitted where applicable.
derivation.serialization: UTF-8, two-space indentation, literal Unicode and one trailing LF; .gitattributes disables text conversion for JSON in this new fixture directory.
